This made it possible to inject HTML through the separator value. The same unsanitised table HTML is produced both for the standard `Special:Ask` render and for its raw request output (`request_type=raw`), so the injection was reachable without authentication. #### Remediation - In all non-wiki output modes (HTML, raw request, file), `sep` is escaped unless it is a safe `
` variant. - This preserves legitimate line-break separators while blocking markup injection. #### Maintenance note If the table renderer ever gains richer separator semantics, keep the whitelist explicit.
